title: Feasibility of ground state spin switching in a molecular analogue of the mixed-metal oxides with the perovskite structure

material_class.structural_family: Ce3Mn8O8 perovskite-related molecular nanoparticle (tetragonally elongated Mn8 cuboid with a central CeIV and two CeIII on opposite faces)

synthesis.procedure: To a stirred solution of 2-Cl-PhCO2H (2.57 g, 16.4 mmol) in MeCN (20 mL) at 55 °C was added solid Mn(PhCO2)2 (0.700 g, 2.05 mmol) to give a light pink solution. After 5 min, Ce(NO3)3·4H2O (0.910 g, 2.05 mmol) was added to give a deep red solution, then solid nBu4NMnO4 (0.19 g, 0.53 mmol) was added in small portions. The dark brown solution was stirred at 55 °C for 1 h, filtered hot, cooled to room temperature, and left undisturbed. The next day it was filtered to remove a small amount of powder. After another 5 days, brown plate-like crystals of 2·2.5MeCN were collected by filtration, washed with Et2O, and dried under vacuum. Yield 21% based on Mn.
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h at 55 °C; crystals after ~6 days total standing
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution, hot filtration, slow crystallization at ambient temperature
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered hot; filtrate cooled and left undisturbed; filtered next day to remove powder; X-ray quality brown plates of 2·2.5MeCN collected after another 5 days, washed with Et2O, dried under vacuum

properties.summary: DC and AC magnetometry of vacuum-dried 2 show ligand-induced perturbation of the Ce3Mn8 core relative to all-benzoate analogue 1. χMT at 300 K is 28.99 cm3 K mol−1, rising to 43.81 cm3 K mol−1 at 30 K then falling to 14.34 cm3 K mol−1 at 5.0 K (0.1 T). Fits to a 4-J model (PHI, g fixed at 2.0, CeIII contribution subtracted) give J1=+6.2, J2=+4.4, J3=−2.6, J4=−0.5 cm−1, suggesting the A-type AF state is much closer to the C-type AF ground state than in 1, but ligand disorder precludes claiming a definite ground-state switch. Low-T AC χ′T extrapolates toward two independent CeIII ions, consistent with an S=0 CeIVMn8III core; no out-of-phase AC signal at 1.8 K.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, 0.1 T dc, vacuum-dried crushed microcrystalline sample in eicosane

measurements.name: J1
measurements.conditions: PHI fit of χMT vs T (CeIII subtracted), 0.1 T, g=2.0 fixed

measurements.name: in-phase χ′MT vs T
measurements.conditions: 1.8–15 K, 3.5 G ac field, 1000 Hz; steep decrease below 15 K; extrapolation to 0 K ~1.60 cm3 K mol−1 (two CeIII); no χ″ signal at 1.8 K
